questions.question: When a large crowd gathered around Jesus, who came to see Him?
Jesus' mother and brothers came to see Him in a crowd and walked right up to Him. True or false?
When Jesus was told His mother and brothers wanted to see Him, who did He say His mother and brothers are?

answers.text: Those who hear God's word and carry it out
Those who follow Him from town to town
Those who sit closest to Him and listen
